blocks.text: Property investment typically comes down to two considerations: the advantages a location offers today and the value it can still create over time. Along Metro Manila’s C5 corridor, both are increasingly evident. Thriving growth corridor A few years ago, C5 Road was still regarded as an emerging proposition—one of the capital’s fringe addresses taking shape beyond traditional central business districts. Today, that proposition is far more established. The corridor has developed into a substantial commercial and residential market, supported by a growing concentration of offices, condominiums, retail centers and mixed-use developments.
